schema.meaning: Compiler-derived effective legacy mapping; absent carrier differs from present empty map; missing provenance is unknown.

local_validation.analysis_format_diff: All modified Dart source and test files clean
local_validation.independent_review: SDK/Flutter/CLI interface and final CI source reviews reported no remaining blockers

roundtrip.method: Actual AOT frontend output verified against serialized Kernel, then production Flutter CopyAssets with memory filesystem/fake process manager, then real CLI archive/checker controls.
roundtrip.fixture_limit: Compiler fixture binding wrapper uses synthetic non-executable bytecode; no native app or replacement runtime was built or executed.

checks: Map canonicalization preserves runtime paths and ignores YAML location/comment/order.
Descriptor write failure is reported before completion and leaves no stale sidecar.
Native YAML participates in kernel dependencies; descriptor participates in output invalidation and assets input.
Full profile rejects trusted output/depfile overrides and verifies reported kernel path.
Unknown old provenance requires native confirmation; asset override cannot bypass.
Unchanged descriptor permits generated App/base structural differences.
ci: New compiler and Flutter mapping gates are configured for all supported SDK/CLI hosts; this checkpoint has not yet completed hosted CI.
limitations: This is compile/tooling validation, not physical iOS FFI acceptance.
Older releases lacking descriptors retain explicit native uncertainty, not reconstructed equivalence.
No frozen iPad engine/SDK outputs were rebuilt.
